text: Preparing a field expedition to the Caspian Sea (May–June 2027) to study carbon cycling in drying lakes.
Leading a hands-on workshop on high-frequency greenhouse-gas sampling and flux processing with goFlux at the GLEON 2026 meeting.
Taught a Google Earth Engine workshop on satellite water monitoring for the Iberian Association of Limnology.
Presented new goFlux functionality and work on river oligotrophication and salinity–carbon links in the River Gambia at EGU 2026.
